patch:
diff --git a/repro.py b/repro.py
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..647a6a64
--- /dev/null
+++ b/repro.py
@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
+from rich.text import Text
+t = Text("Hello", style="bold")
+try:
+    t.append(t)
+    print("Success")
+except Exception as e:
+    print(f"Error: {e}")
diff --git a/repro_text.py b/repro_text.py
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..4857b4f0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/repro_text.py
@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
+from rich.text import Text
+t = Text("Hello", style="bold")
+try:
+    t.append_text(t)
+    print("Success")
+except Exception as e:
+    print(f"Error: {e}")
diff --git a/rich/text.py b/rich/text.py

                 self._text.append(text.plain)

-                    for start, end, style in text._spans
+                    for start, end, style in list(text._spans)
                 )
                 self._length += len(text)
         return self
@@ -1020,7 +1020,7 @@ class Text(JupyterMixin):

             _Span(start + text_length, end + text_length, style)
